metaDescription: A guided check, one question at a time: what is fine, what is not, and the list of what to replace.
title: Bike checkup
intro: One question at a time. Answer what you see — the to-fix list builds itself.
needsBike: The checkup needs to know which bike you have. Open your bike, then start the checkup from the Actions tab.
emptyBody: No question applies to the parts you picked. Try a full checkup.

tools.title: Tools for this checkup
tools.intro: This is what the guides in this checkup ask for. Tick anything you do not have and we will offer a stand-in when it matters.
tools.missing: I do not have this tool
tools.noAlternative: No stand-in: skip the step, or ask a shop.

step.substitutionNone: {tool}: there is no stand-in. Skip this step, or ask a shop.

verdict.shortcuts: Keyboard shortcuts: 1 for “it's fine”, 2 for “it's not fine”, 3 to skip.

save.failed: This checkup could not be saved on this device.

summary.title: Summary
summary.intro: Here is what you answered. You can still change a verdict before creating the list.
summary.open: {count, plural, =1 {1 question is still unanswered.} other {# questions are still unanswered.}}
summary.nothingToDo: Nothing to replace: your bike passed the checkup.
